shortDescription: Manage Load balancer (gateway) endpoints on StorageGRID.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the StorageGRID Admin Node REST API.

options.name: auth_token
options.description: The authorization token for the API request

options.name: binding_mode
options.description: Binding mode to restrict accessibility of the load balancer endpoint. A binding mode other than I(global) requires StorageGRID 11.5 or greater.

options.name: ca_bundle
options.description: Intermediate CA certificate bundle in concatenated PEM-encoding. Omit when there is no intermediate CA.

options.name: closed_on_untrusted_client_network
options.description: Whether to close the port on an untrusted Client Network.

options.name: default_service_type
options.description: The type of service to proxy through the load balancer.

options.name: display_name
options.description: A display name for the configuration. This parameter can be modified if I(gateway_id) is also specified.

options.name: enable_grid_manager
options.description: Whether to use the port bind for grid manager traffic.

options.name: enable_ipv4
options.description: Indicates whether to listen for connections on IPv4.

options.name: enable_ipv6
options.description: Indicates whether to listen for connections on IPv6.

options.name: enable_tenant_manager
options.description: Whether to use the port bind for tenant manager traffic.

options.name: gateway_id
options.description: ID of the load balancer endpoint.

options.name: ha_groups
options.description: A set of StorageGRID HA Groups by name or UUID to bind the load balancer endpoint to. Option is ignored unless I(binding_mode=ha-groups).

options.name: node_interfaces
options.description: A set of StorageGRID node interfaces to bind the load balancer endpoint to.

options.name: node_type
options.description: A list of node types to bind to. This Load Balancer Endpoint will listen on all nodes of this type. The adminNode type includes both primary and non-primary admin nodes.

options.name: port
options.description: The TCP port to serve traffic on. This parameter cannot be modified after the load balancer endpoint has been created.

options.name: private_key
options.description: Certficate private key in PEM-encoding. Required if I(server_certificate) is not empty.

options.name: secure
options.description: Whether the load balancer endpoint serves HTTP or HTTPS traffic. This parameter cannot be modified after the load balancer endpoint has been created.

options.name: server_certificate
options.description: X.509 server certificate in PEM-encoding. Omit if using default certificates.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified load balancer endpoint should be configured.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Should https certificates be validated?
